title: Synthesis and characterization of thermolatent bases with varying activation temperatures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35265-35280
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05095B, Paper

Matthias Udo Mayer-Kriehuber, Evelyn Sattler, David Reisinger, Daniel Bautista-Anguís, Szymon Gaca, Christoph Schmidleitner, Ivica Duretek, Elvira Vidovic, Sandra Schlögl
A library of quaternary ammonium salts acting as thermolatent Brønsted base generators has been synthetized. The relationship between molecular structure and thermal stability has been studied systematically to tune the temperature of base release.
